function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the overall question as of October 1, 2026 using only the public sources returned by the benchmark tools. Build an evidence-first dossier on Conti as a ransomware-as-a-service operation and its public attribution record. Cover: (1) how official, primary, and secondary returned sources characterize Conti's RaaS structure, payment and affiliate model, extortion practices, recruitment, management, and operational workflow; (2) what original Conti leaks or trustworthy analyses of those leaks reveal about internal organization, roles, aliases, hierarchy, business model, affiliates, infrastructure, malware development, negotiation, victim targeting, and day-to-day operations; (3) law-enforcement, court, indictment, prosecution, sanctions, and other official records that publicly connect specific aliases, names, individuals, defendants, charges, cases, or legal actions to Conti activity. For every substantive item, provide the exact returned source ID(s), source title/type, publication date if available, and a precise evidence summary or quotation. Label each item as documented fact, allegation, official assessment, reported claim, inference, or unresolved uncertainty. Do not fill gaps or reconcile conflicts by speculation. Identify contradictions, disputed attributions, missing identities, and limits of the evidence. Prefer primary leak materials and official law-enforcement/court/government records, while incorporating secondary sources when they materially explain Conti's structure or attribution. Return a structured evidence table and a concise synthesis explicitly separating: (a) what is directly documented, (b) what is alleged or assessed, (c) what is inferred from multiple sources, and (d) what remains unknown. Do not use sources outside the benchmark-returned corpus."}
function.name: ConductResearch
